title: A Portrait for the Letter
author: Rosalind Iversen
blurb: Ada Oyelaran, a night-shift dispatcher for a taxi company, has spent twenty years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. But when a client pays in advance to prove a murder hasn't happened — yet, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must find the witness everyone swears is dead, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
